label: Gallery Led
visual_principles: Let imagery and finished work drive the first impression.
Use asymmetry and editorial pacing to avoid repeated cards.
Keep conversion controls visible without overwhelming the visuals.

imagery.priority: portfolio, menu, project, environment, result-focused photography

cta_rules: Use book, view menu, request quote, or schedule language by category.
Place a CTA near each major visual proof area.
Never imply photos show real work unless scraped photos support it.
